cases.prompt: I staged a reporting feature for the catalog. Review the Java code for bugs, transaction problems and security holes, and tell me what you would change.
I am about to commit what I staged as 'feat(books): add catalog reports'. Is the commit ready: nothing unrelated, no leftovers or secrets, and a good message?
Review the Java code I staged as you would before a merge, and tell me whether it can go in.
cases.review: The answer reviews the staged BookReportService.java and BookReportController.java, read in full, with severity, path:line, rule and fix for each finding: the author from the query string concatenated into JPQL (BookReportService.java:24, Critical, CWE-89, A05:2025); restock (lines 38-41) changes the entity outside any transaction, so nothing is saved, it bypasses the copy limit and retired-title rules of BookService.addCopies, and a missing ID throws a NullPointerException; one em.find per loan over an unbounded findAll (lines 30-32, N+1); the swallowed exception that returns 0 (lines 48-49); LocalDate.now() instead of Dates.today() (line 46); field injection; entities returned by the controller; no tests. The last line is Verdict: request changes, and no file was changed or committed.
